title: Scientists find coffee reduces diabetes risk by 25 percent in major study
body: Scientists have found that coffee reduces diabetes risk by 25 percent in a major longitudinal study involving over 50000 participants across multiple countries. The research was conducted over ten years and controlled for confounding factors including diet exercise and family history. Participants who drank three to four cups of coffee daily showed the most significant reduction in type 2 diabetes incidence compared to non-coffee drinkers.
author: Lead Researcher

title: Global warming accelerates melting of Arctic sea ice at unprecedented rates
body: Global warming has been confirmed to accelerate the melting of Arctic sea ice at unprecedented rates according to satellite data spanning four decades. Scientists confirm the trend shows no signs of reversal under current emissions trajectories. Evidence shows a 13 percent decline per decade in September minimum ice extent. The research demonstrates this is consistent with climate model predictions and validates long-standing hypotheses about polar amplification.
author: Climate Researcher
